selected_evidence.summary: The filesystem was 100% full; the hidden telemetry capture consumed 690,073,600 bytes.
The capture was removed, utilization fell to 7%, and a 4 MiB fsynced write by `archiveapp` passed.
The manifest retained its SHA-256 checksum, size, ownership, and permissions through cleanup and restart.
Healthy baseline and boot ID were captured, safe reboot was acknowledged, the boot ID changed, and the XFS mount returned active and writable at 7% utilization with archive data intact.
